about: The move of the academy from Fulshear to Richmond, TX. Everything the move script needs to know. Nothing in this folder is published: it lives on the working branch only, and apply_move.py edits a separate checkout of main on the day.
effective_date_note: Tentative. The owner said 'July 1st' on 2026-10-15, so this is July 1, 2027. apply_move.py refuses to run before this date unless --allow-early.

new.source: The address is from the owner's lease rider (10330 Hidden Lake Ln - Building 1, Richmond TX 77406), received 2026-10-15.
new.coordinates_note: US Census geocoder, interpolated along the street. Replace with the entrance's own coordinates (drop a pin in Google Maps at the door) before the move, and the map pin, the geo tags and the structured data all follow.

facts.route_from_old_academy: Cross Creek Ranch Boulevard, FM 1093, Canyon Fields Drive, Reese Lake Drive, Fulshear-Gaston Road and Hidden Lake Lane
facts.source: OSRM driving routes on OpenStreetMap data, 2026-10-15; see routes.json

katy.note: The other academy. Only its coordinates are used here (routes_both.json).
